name: +1 Size Every Second
desc:
🌟 +1 Size Every Second 🌟

In this addictive growth game, every second you get bigger, and every obstacle is a new challenge.

🏆 How to play:

Grow automatically every second — no need to move!

🧱 Use your size to overcome obstacles, reach new zones, and impress the server.

🔁 Rebirth to reset your size but unlock even faster growth with each cycle.

🛍️ Upgrade your growth multiplier to become the largest player of all time.

Can you tower over everyone else and become the biggest in the universe?

👍 Like the game to promote future updates!
